description: Implementation of QuicClientBase class and related path validation delegates for QUIC protocol client functionality.

classes.name: QuicClientSocketMigrationValidationResultDelegate
classes.description: Handles path validation results for connection migration, triggers path migration on success, logs failure.

classes.name: ServerPreferredAddressResultDelegateWithWriter
classes.description: Handles server address validation success, transfers ownership of writer.

classes.name: ValidationResultDelegate
classes.description: Handles path validation results, adds validated paths or logs failure.

classes.name: QuicClientBase
classes.description: Implements QUIC client connection management, including connection, migration, validation, and session handling.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the client, sets flow control windows, creates UDP socket.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Attempts to establish a connection, retries with different versions if needed.

methods.name: StartConnect
methods.description: Begins connection process, creates session and sets up connection parameters.

methods.name: InitializeSession
methods.description: Initializes the current session.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Closes connection and cleans up sockets.

methods.name: proof_verifier
methods.description: Returns the proof verifier used for authentication.

methods.name: EncryptionBeingEstablished
methods.description: Checks if encryption handshake is in progress.

methods.name: WaitForEvents
methods.description: Runs event loop until events are processed.

methods.name: WaitForEventsPostprocessing
methods.description: Post-processing after event loop, attempts reconnect if needed.

methods.name: MigrateSocket
methods.description: Migrates socket to a new host.

methods.name: MigrateSocketWithSpecifiedPort
methods.description: Migrates socket to a new host and port.

methods.name: ValidateAndMigrateSocket
methods.description: Validates path to new host and initiates migration asynchronously.

methods.name: CreateWriterForNewNetwork
methods.description: Creates a new packet writer for a new network address.

methods.name: ChangeEphemeralPort
methods.description: Changes port to a new ephemeral port.

methods.name: session
methods.description: Returns current QUIC session.

methods.name: network_helper
methods.description: Returns network helper object.

methods.name: WaitForStreamToClose
methods.description: Waits until a specific stream is closed.

methods.name: WaitForOneRttKeysAvailable
methods.description: Waits until 1-RTT keys are available.

methods.name: WaitForHandshakeConfirmed
methods.description: Waits until handshake is confirmed.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Checks if client is connected.

methods.name: goaway_received
methods.description: Checks if GOAWAY received.

methods.name: GetNumSentClientHellos
methods.description: Returns number of client hellos sent.

methods.name: UpdateStats
methods.description: Updates statistics related to client hellos.

methods.name: GetNumReceivedServerConfigUpdates
methods.description: Returns number of server config updates received.

methods.name: connection_error
methods.description: Returns last connection error code.

methods.name: GetNextConnectionId
methods.description: Generates or returns override connection ID.

methods.name: GenerateNewConnectionId
methods.description: Creates a new random connection ID.

methods.name: GetClientConnectionId
methods.description: Creates a new random client connection ID.

methods.name: CanReconnectWithDifferentVersion
methods.description: Checks if reconnection with a different version is possible.

methods.name: HasPendingPathValidation
methods.description: Checks if there is a pending path validation.

methods.name: ValidateNewNetwork
methods.description: Validates and initiates migration to a new network.

methods.name: OnServerPreferredAddressAvailable
methods.description: Handles server preferred address notification and initiates validation.
